name: persona
tagline: Somewhere for an assistant to keep a model of itself and get it back later.
description: A small identity card plus two kinds of knowledge the assistant writes for itself: typed fields it defines and fills, and free-text notes. Both are searchable, carry provenance and can be pinned into the identity block loaded at the start of a turn. One persona per profile, so a work assistant and a home assistant are different people. Four rules, each an ADR with a test: a persona is data, never instructions.
highlights: Assistant-defined schema that grows as it learns
